summary: Consumer Reports reports that Instacart users were subject to AI-enabled price experiments in which identical items sometimes appeared at different prices. Instacart characterized the tests as limited, short-term, randomized retailer tests, denied using personal or demographic data for grocery prices, and said some item price experiments had stopped at Costco and Target; the article also discusses Eversight, patents, behavioral data, and possible surveillance-pricing risks.
